connector.name: Engine
connector.registryDescription: AIN bias & stability engine: finance, gaming, AI, crypto. 68 tools across 11 categories.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package zpl-engine-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cicicalex account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZPL_API_KEY
env.description: User API key from zeropointlogic.io/dashboard/api-keys. Format: zpl_u_ + 48 hex chars. Service keys (zpl_s_) are rejected since v3.5.0.

env.name: ZPL_MODE
env.description: pure (default) hides AIN score from the AI on text-evaluation tools to prevent observer effect. coach exposes the score.

env.name: ZPL_ENGINE_URL
env.description: Engine base URL. Defaults to https://engine.zeropointlogic.io.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Only required for the 8 AI-eval tools (zpl_consistency_test, zpl_sycophancy_score, etc). Session capped at 100 Claude calls per process.
